title: Italian Salsa Verde with Capers
summary: Bread, olive oil and lemon blended smooth, then pulsed with parsley, anchovies, capers and garlic into a vibrant, textured sauce.

steps.title: Dry the bread
steps.text: Toast the bread lightly so it dries without browning, then tear it into small pieces.

steps.title: Make the base
steps.text: Blitz the bread, oil and lemon juice in the food processor for about 10 s until smooth.

steps.title: Pulse the herbs
steps.text: Add the parsley, anchovies, capers and garlic. Pulse 4-5 times, scraping down once, until finely chopped but not puréed.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon over baked or grilled white fish, chicken or boiled potatoes.

tips: Make sure the parsley is completely dry.
Pulse briefly; over-processing turns the sauce muddy.
Swap some parsley for basil or mint.
storage: Cover the surface with a thin layer of oil and refrigerate for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
